title: Chris Heuer (Alynd founder) — the FedCo / Price Club / Costco through-line and 'doing the hard thing is where all the value is'
summary: Chris Heuer — founder of Alynd and longtime social business practitioner — endorses Incorruptible on LinkedIn, elevating the FedCo / Price Club / Costco through-line as the case that proves the right thing is the durable thing.
blockquote: Hoping that more people read Eric Ries' book to understand this better and to see the great examples like #FedCo, the precursor to #PriceClub and #Costco. Anything worth doing is worth doing right. Doing the right thing is seldom the easy path. Figuring out how to do the hard thing is where all the value is.
